differences: Experiment 1 exclusion rates computed from the paper's criteria are 15.2% (young) and 22.6% (senior) against 15.5% and 22.9% in the paper (SDs match); the cause is not stated in the paper.
The deposit's column description for the Trail Making Test says milliseconds; the values are in seconds.

Experiment 2: trials excluded by the latency criterion (3.8% young, 10.1% senior) and the duration criterion (1.2% and 2.1%) reproduce the paper, but the horizontal-amplitude criterion removes 5.7% and 15.5% of trials here against 7.5% and 20.4% in the paper, so the total exclusion rates are lower here (6.6% and 17.2%, paper 9.1% and 20.7%). The paper does not say how the amplitude was measured for that criterion.
Four participants in Experiment 2 and one in Experiment 1 have an incomplete row in the cognitive file; missing values are left empty.
